premises.text: Product delivery tools leave teams unable to gather scattered feedback and prioritize real customer needs, so they build unwanted features
premises.evidence_span: tools that are optimized and designed for product delivery, not the crucial part of product discovery

premises.text: Product Board is a product-management system of record that unifies research inputs, need-linked feature prioritization, interactive roadmaps, and handoff to engineering systems
premises.evidence_span: Product Board is a system of record for product management

premises.text: The offering serves the whole company as a hub for product discovery, not only product managers
premises.evidence_span: this isn't just a tool for product managers, because at a typical product company, everyone wants to contribute and be part of the product management process

premises.text: Revenue model is a per-user tiered subscription; acquisition uses content marketing plus inside sales
premises.evidence_span: We offer a subscription service with a per user tiered pricing starting at $24 a month

value.text: Help product makers make products people want
value.evidence_span: Our mission at Product Board is to help you make products people want

causal_links.evidence_span: building products means nothing if they're not the right products
understand what people need, prioritize what to build
help you make products people want
